name: Helen Keller Intl vitamin A
summary: Vitamin A supplements for children aged 6–59 months, twice a year. A re-implementation of GiveWell's model. GiveWell models 33 locations; this page shows Togo, the median location by cost-effectiveness. The others are listed below.
